meta.siteTitle: Stars Media — Sports marketing for athletes
meta.siteDescription: Stars Media builds visibility, strengthens athlete brands and creates opportunities beyond the pitch.

graphics.name: Sports Graphic Design
graphics.summary: Graphics for the moments that mark a season: signings, goals, call-ups and awards.
graphics.benefit: Your profile looks professional from the first post.

branding.name: Athlete Branding
branding.summary: An identity of your own — mark, colours, type and tone — kept consistent everywhere you appear.
branding.benefit: People recognise you before they read your name.

matchday.name: Matchday Designs
matchday.summary: Announcements, line-ups and results designed for match rhythm and ready while the moment is still live.
matchday.benefit: Every match day adds to your image, win or lose.

video.name: Highlight Videos
video.summary: Your best actions edited into a reel that shows how you play.
video.benefit: Scouts, coaches and agents can judge you in minutes.

content.name: Sports Content Creation
content.summary: Photos, short videos and stories planned around your season.
content.benefit: There is always something worth publishing.

marketing.name: Digital Marketing
marketing.summary: Campaigns that take your name beyond the people who already follow you.
marketing.benefit: You reach clubs, sponsors and press, not only supporters.

social.name: Social Media Strategy
social.summary: A plan for what to post, when and why.
social.benefit: Your profiles keep working for your career between matches.

discover.name: Discover Athletes
discover.text: A public showcase of athletes working with Stars Media, searchable by position, nationality and club.

profiles.name: Athlete Profiles
profiles.text: A professional page for each athlete — a digital sporting CV with its own link, published only with the athlete's authorisation.

portfolio.name: Athlete Portfolio
portfolio.text: Videos, photos, graphics and verified statistics in one place, ready to send to agents, coaches and clubs.

media.text: Free guides on branding, social media and how to present a football career.

dashboard.text: A private area for clients: requests, delivered materials and project history.

intro.text: Stars Media is a sports marketing agency built around the athlete. We design the graphics, shape the identity and plan the content that show a player at their true level — to supporters, to clubs and to the people who decide careers.

services.title: Seven ways we work on your image
services.closing: Find the right solution for your career.

platform.note: These areas open in the next phases of the site.

cta.title: Your journey deserves the right presentation.
cta.text: Tell us where you are in your career and where you want to be seen.

about.title: We work on how the game sees you.
about.lead: Talent is decided on the pitch. Whether it gets noticed depends on how it is presented. Stars Media exists for that second part.
about.photoAlt: Football player in a white kit, seen in profile during a match
about.positioning: An international sports marketing agency focused on athletes — not on leagues or sponsors. Everything we produce starts from one question: what does this player need people to see?
about.mission: To give athletes at every stage of their career the presentation, visibility and tools usually reserved for the few at the top.

understand.name: Understand
understand.text: We start with you: position, moment of career, goals and the audience you need to reach.

define.name: Define
define.text: We set the identity — the look, the tone and the story your profiles will tell.

produce.name: Produce
produce.text: Graphics, matchday designs, videos and content are created to that identity.

publish.name: Publish
publish.text: We plan what goes out and when, then adjust to how people respond.

about.values: Performance. Exclusivity. Innovation. Ambition. Credibility. International reach. Sporting excellence.

servicesPage.title: Find the right solution for your career.
servicesPage.lead: Every athlete is at a different point. We combine the services that fit yours, so nothing is forced into a fixed package.
servicesPage.note: Each solution is put together for the athlete, so we present options and values in conversation. Tell us about your moment and we will show you what fits.
